title: ShortcutsConfig
description: Configuration schema for browser homepage shortcuts

icon.description: Icon descriptor: 1) Lucide icon name (e.g. 'search', 'globe'); 2) Standalone local SVG with 'svg:' prefix (e.g. 'svg:google'); 3) Text monogram up to 3 characters with 'text:' prefix (e.g. 'text:AWS', 'text:G'). Must not be empty.

color.description: Optional custom color for Lucide icons or Text monograms. Defaults to neutral theme-aware gray.

iconSvg.description: Legacy inline SVG string for backwards compatibility
